ashley (eng-lead): Cutting RC from main: artifact=rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-3 (sha:a1b2c3d). Requesting pin + signoff for promo window 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need KV-warm and prefix cache before canary. @nina please smoke.

deploybot: CI: ✅ all checks passed, image pushed to registry (gcr/redwood/rwinf:rc-2026-03-21-3). Canary slot available. Can schedule KV-warm 30m prior.

nina (qa): Starting smoke suite now (chatgen, embeddings, reranking quick checks). Will post results in ~8m.

mara (eng): Approve pin request for artifact=rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-3. Locking rollout plan: canary=3% -> 20% over 15m; health probe p95 < 350ms.

sam (sre): Scheduled KV warm job: `/ops/run_kv_warm --artifact rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-3 --workers=8 --duration=25m --region=us-west1`
Logs tail: ```
[kv_warm] warming shards 0..127
[kv_warm] warmed 12k keys/sec, estimated fill 18m
[kv_warm] finished, latency steady
```

oncall-sheriff: Rollback plan reviewed. Command ready: `deploybot rollback --artifact rwinf-stable-2026-03-18-7 --reason=auto-rollback`
Abort criteria (checked): p95 latency > 500ms for 5m OR error rate > 2% sustained over 3m OR canary traffic drop > 30%.

leo (product): Release notes blurb: "Performance and stability: improved KV cache warming and batching heuristics; no breaking changes." Keep language customer-friendly.

ashley (eng-lead): Final sanity check & +1s? tagging leads: @mara @sam @nina @leo

nina (qa): +1 smoke finished: 3/3 critical tests PASS (chatgen basic, embeddings freshness, rerank sanity). Snippet: ```
SMOKE SUMMARY: PASS
chatgen.latency_p95=310ms
embeddings.cosine_sample=0.98
```

sam (sre): +1 infra checks OK. Network, autoscaler, and KV quotas validated. I'll monitor live metrics during canary.

deploybot: Promotion scheduled: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z (canary start). Will post canary status and promote per health policy.

ashley (eng-lead): Pin written to release-log: `{rc: rwinf-rc-2026-03-21-3, pinned_by: ashley, reason: kv/cache perf fix}` Thanks team :tada: If no objections, radio silent until canary start.

mara (eng): Noted. I'll leave KV warm window open 30m before promo and verify cache hitrate >= 85% prior to traffic shift.

oncall-sheriff: I'll be on-call during the window. If we need emergency rollback, I'll execute the rollback command and announce in #incidents.

ashley (eng-lead): Closing thread — we're green to proceed.
